reader.requirement: At --std 85 the file must never hold two records with equal prime record key values: a WRITE whose prime key equals that of a record already in the file (open OUTPUT or I-O, any access mode, fixed or variable-length records) must be unsuccessful, not take place, leave the record area unaffected and raise the invalid key condition with I-O status 22 (sequential access in OUTPUT/EXTEND detects the equal key as the GR17a ascending-sequence violation, status 21), whatever the alternate keys hold.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility: at 85 no sharing arbitration on the store attach / file lock (OPEN time); the WRITE uniqueness test itself is unaffected
InForce (Year < 2002): a WRITE with no INVALID KEY needs a USE procedure at 85 (SR3)

reader.edition-search: Read IndexedConnector.Write: the prime-key test (_st.Get on the prime tree -> '22', and the sequential '21' before it) has no DialectBehaviors / Edition test; grep of DialectBehaviors.IsActive over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO finds only READ (lines 445, 580), relative WRITE, sharing and report-writer sites.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness l1c37 covers random access OUTPUT with a duplicate (22, area unaffected, original record kept); not exercised there: dynamic access, I-O mode against existing records, sequential access OUTPUT/EXTEND, LOW-VALUES keys, a duplicate prime with a distinct alternate, variable-length records.

probes.expected: GR12 / GR17b: 22 on an equal prime key; GR18 area unaffected

probes.expected: uniqueness in every open mode and access mode; sequential equal key is also GR17a's '21'

reader.notes: GR12 is a requirement on the file's content that the standard enforces through GR17b's invalid key; IndexedConnector.Write looks the prime value up in the prime tree before any alternate test and returns 22 without touching the store. Where sequential access makes the equal key also a GR17a sequence error the runtime answers 21 first; 1985 IX-4 states no precedence between 21 and 22, and either is an invalid key with the write not taking place.
